mapper.select:
SELECT id, iso2, iso3, name, name_en AS nameEn, name_ch AS nameCh, icon_base64 AS iconBase64, phone_code AS phoneCode, currency_code AS currencyCode, max_level AS maxLevel, status, sort, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM geo_country WHERE status = 1
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name_en LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR name_ch LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR iso2 LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY sort ASC, id ASC
